name: The Ice Guard

guaranteedRewards.name: Ice Guard
tooltip: Use: Permanently adds 10 frost resistance to a leg or head slot item. Does not stack with other enchantments for the selected equipment slot.

statusNote: Changed in Forever. Pays -30g instead of 0. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Ah, the Ice Guard. It is a thin sheen of protective magic that covers certain pieces of equipment. Those that do battle with creatures of frost and ice will gain increased protection from their attacks by using the Ice Guard.

As with all things the Wrathcaster creates, there is a price - a price that I will not lower, regardless of how much you whimper. Interested?
narrative.objectives: Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 10 Insignia of the Crusade and 30 gold.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Mataus pockets the gold.>Enjoy the repair costs, friend. Naxxramas is 'unkind' to the uninitiated.
narrative.requestItemsText: If it were not for these Argent Dawn guards, you would be a stain upon this floor.
